name: Bourn vita
ingredients_raw: Cereal Extract 51%* (Barley, Wheat), Sugar, Cocoa Solids, Caramel (150c), Liquid Glucose, Protein Isolate, Maltodextrin, Milk Solids, Vitamins, Emulsifiers (322, 471), Raising Agent (500(ii)), Minerals, & CONTAINS PERMITTED NATURAL COLOUR Edible (150c) AND ADDED FLAVOUR (ARTIFICIAL (VANILLA) FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES) Allergen Information: Contains Wheat, Milk, Barley, Sulphites. STORAGE CONDITIONS: STORE IN A COOL, HYGIENIC AND DRY PLACE. BEST BEFORE 12 MONTHS FROM PACKAGING INSTRUCTIONS FOR USE: Rad 2-heaped teaspoons (20 g") 0 Bournvita to a cun of Closo
